camel_example: aliyun vpc DeletionProtection --region cn-hangzhou --ProtectionEnable true --Type EIP --InstanceId 'eip-uf6id7gvguruxe41v0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Sets the deletion protection feature for an instance
description_zh: 设置实例删除保护功能
kebab_example: aliyun vpc deletion-protection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --protection-enable true --type EIP --instance-id eip-uf6id7gvguruxe41v0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletionProtection

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance for which you want to set deletion protection. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 要设置删除保护功能的实例所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启删除保护功能，取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭
parameters.name: protection_enable

parameters.help_en:
The type of instance for which you want to set deletion protection. Valid values:

EIP: elastic IP address.

CBWP: Internet Shared Bandwidth.

NATGW: NAT gateway
parameters.help_zh:
要设置删除保护功能的实例类型，取值：

EIP：弹性公网IP。

CBWP：共享带宽。

NATGW：NAT网关
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance for which you want to set deletion protection
parameters.help_zh: 要设置删除保护功能的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
